tools.content:
# Graph task terms

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Graph | A set of Nodes and paths that controls a task. |
| Node | One step in the Graph. |
| Checkpoint | A saved record of the Graph state that can help it continue. |

Use these names when explaining this task. A Checkpoint does not guarantee that an external action happens only once.

reply:
Context: This is about how a Graph continues after you approve a step. The Graph is a set of Nodes, and each Node is one step in the task.

When you approve, the Graph waits at a confirmation boundary. It saves a Checkpoint. The Checkpoint is a saved record of the Graph state. This Checkpoint links your reply to the step that was paused. After the Graph continues, the next Node makes the report.

Please note: a Checkpoint does not guarantee that an external action happens only once. So if the system crashes, the write to an external file may happen more than once.
